newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZAMBIA STOCKS WEEK - Zambia Sugar leads trade.
newsitem.headline: ZAMBIA STOCKS WEEK - Zambia Sugar leads trade.

text.p: Activity slowed on the Lusaka stock exchange in the week ended May 30, exchange officials said.
They said traded volume dropped to 357,125 shares valued at 12,912,599 kwacha from 523,989 shares valued at 32,583,428 kwacha the previous week.
Zambia Sugar fell 1.5 kwacha to end the week at 23.50 and saw 279,597 shares valued at 6,819,925 kwacha exchanging hands.
Rothmans gained 1.75 kwacha to close at 45 kwacha in a traded volume of 10,000 shares valued at 450,000 kwacha.
Chilanga Cement gained 0.25 kwacha to close at 86.25 kwacha in a traded volume of 64,749 shares worth 5,609,326 kwacha.
Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM), Trans Zambezi Industries and Farmers House - the three other companies listed on the exchange - were untraded during the week.
Meanwhile, a Zambia Breweries floatation of 13 million ordinary shares ahead of the company's planned listing on June 6 closed over-subscribed by around 55 percent, exchange officials said.
The listing of Zambian Breweries will bring to seven, the number of companies listed on the exchange.
